DeepCool PL550D 550 Watt Non-Modular 80 Plus Bronze ATX 3.0 Power Supply

The DeepCool PL550D 550 Watt Non-Modular 80 Plus Bronze  Power Supply is designed to deliver dependable performance for modern gaming and productivity systems. Built with the latest ATX 3.0 standard, this PSU ensures improved power stability, better efficiency, and support for high-power GPUs through its native 12VHPWR (16-pin) connector. With 80 Plus Bronze efficiency, it operates at up to 85% power efficiency, keeping your PC cooler and reducing unnecessary energy loss. The PL550D uses a high-quality 120mm hydro-dynamic bearing fan, providing quiet cooling performance while maintaining long-term reliability.

Its DC-to-DC conversion technology ensures stable voltage output even under fluctuating loads, making it ideal for gaming, rendering, and multitasking. Safety is prioritized with full protection features including OCP, OVP, SCP, OPP, UVP, OTP, and SIP, giving your components maximum protection against electrical hazards. The non-modular design ensures durability and dependable cable connections, while its compact ATX size fits seamlessly into most PC cases. Backed by a 5-year warranty, the DeepCool PL550D is a perfect choice for users seeking a powerful, efficient, and future-ready PSU for their next PC build.
